We use the dataset from  [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) to test how to embed python code and output into html page via Quarto.

First step, we load the pengiuin data set and check what it has. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

head(penguins)
```

now let us find out the average bill length (mm) of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen island. 

```{r}
pgs <- penguins |> filter(species == 'Adelie' & island == 'Torgersen') |>
    select("bill_length_mm") |>
    map_dbl(mean, na.rm = TRUE)

```

The average bill length of Adelie pengiuns on Torgersen is `{r} round(pgs, 1)` mm.
